remarks: This charming cape cod style home located in desirable Springdale neighborhood is just minutes away from the Springdale train station and downtown Stamford offering easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Four bedrooms offer plenty of space for family members or guests. The partially finished basement provides additional living space, perfect for a home office, gym, playroom or movie oasis.  Outside, the private backyard oasis is perfect for outdoor entertaining, featuring a spacious double deck. A detached one-car garage could be reconstructed as an office, studio or flex space for hobbies. With its timeless appeal, this home is truly a gem in the Stamford community.
